sentences.en: The train was not so crowded as I had expected.
sentences.zh: 火车没有我预期的那么拥挤。

sentences.en: The yen is expected to lose value against the dollar.
sentences.zh: 日元预计会贬值对美元。

sentences.en: As was to be expected, he took the first place.
sentences.zh: 不出所料，他获得了第一名。

senses.zh: （用作定语）预期要发生的；期待中的
预料；要求；认为（某事）会发生
